info.name: SaaS Enterprise Auth, MFA Roles and Permissions API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the NestJS enterprise authentication system, including authentication and registration, MFA, roles, permissions, and permission groups.

request.description: Step 1 of the multi-step registration flow. Generates a pending inactive user and triggers an email verification OTP code.
Resends a fresh 6-digit email verification OTP code to the pending registration session.
Verifies the 6-digit registration OTP code, marking the email as verified.
Step 3 of registration. Sets the account password and fully activates the user. Requires manual login afterwards (no tokens are issued).

exec: console.log("Captured short-lived mfaPendingToken. Proceed to complete login at mid-login verification endpoint!");

request.description: Standard login with credentials. This captures accessToken and refreshToken for all protected collections, including Roles and Permissions. Set loginIdentifier/loginPassword in the environment to switch users.
Rotates current active JWT access and refresh token pair using Refresh Token Rotation (RTR) replay/reuse prevention logic.
Fetch details of the currently authenticated active session.
Allows changing password from inside active authenticated session. Triggers database force revocation on all other sessions.
Password recovery Step 1: Searches user and dispatches password recovery OTP code email (preventing user enumeration leaks).
Password recovery Step 2: Validates reset OTP code, returning success without tokens.
Password recovery Step 3: Hashes new password and terminates all active sessions across all devices.
Google Single Sign-On (SSO) OAuth callback code exchange with auto-registration, multi-provider mapping linking, and mock bypass flags for offline local dev tests.
GitHub Single Sign-On (SSO) OAuth callback code exchange with auto-registration, multi-provider mapping linking, and mock bypass flags for offline local dev tests.

exec: console.log("Cleared Postman tokens on logout complete.");

request.description: Logout the active user session. Revokes the session in the database and invalidates associated refresh tokens.

item.name: 2. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

request.description: MFA Step 1: Protected JWT request to initiate TOTP setup. Encrypts the derived base32 secret in the database and returns a Base64 encoded QR Code data URL.
MFA Step 2: Validates the TOTP authenticator code, fully enables MFA on the account, and returns 8 bcrypt-hashed backup codes *once*.

exec: console.log("MFA Verification Successful! Authorized Session Tokens captured.");

request.description: Completes standard logins when MFA is active. Accepts the short-lived `mfaPendingToken` combined with either a 6-digit TOTP code or an 8-character single-use backup code. Returns active JWT session tokens.
Public endpoint confirming the email token link generated when standard logins detect an unrecognized userAgent/device details.
Requires a valid TOTP code to confirm authorization, purges old backup codes, and returns 8 fresh new ones.
Deactivates Multi-Factor Authentication. Requires a valid TOTP confirmation code and terminates all backup codes.

item.name: MFA Account Recovery Step 1: Request Link

request.description: Step 1 of MFA account recovery. Generates a secure recovery token and dispatches an email containing the link to disable MFA (preventing user enumeration leaks).

item.name: MFA Account Recovery Step 2: Confirm Link

request.description: Step 2 of MFA account recovery. Validates the emailed recovery link token, dispatches deactivation, and purges MFA settings on the user account.
